podcast.body: This song from the 1993 album `Happy Hour` was a major label single for King Missile and performed very well on radio. However, its unique nature also negatively impacted the band's subsequent career, as their other material was not similar. "That was a major label single for King Missile in 1993, seriously, and it did very well at radio. But it also screwed the band for the rest of their career because most of the other material wasn't anything like that."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
